svg.text: 🤖 R-BOT PERFBOARD WIRING & PIN ARCHITECTURE (10×22 GRID)
Skema Solder Perfboard Lengkap • MAX98357A Vin, GND, SD, GAIN Detail • SDA ke GPIO 4 & SCK ke GPIO 5 • ESP32-S3 N16R8

g.text: ⚠️ BTL: SPK- JANGAN ke GND! Langsung ke Speaker
SD & GAIN: Biarkan KOSONG (Default Aktif 9dB Stereo-Mix)
🔋 DISTRIBUSI DAYA MH-CD42 (IP5306) & RINGKASAN AUDIT KELISTRIKAN
• VOUT+ (5.0V) ➔ Pin 5Vin ESP32, VCC Motor, Vin Amp
✓ IP5306 Bebas Auto-Sleep: Beban ESP32 ~120mA stabil
• Sinyal Terpasang: LCD SDA = GPIO 4 | LCD SCK = GPIO 5
• MAX98357A: Vin ke 5V | GND ke GND | SD & GAIN (Open)
• Strapping Safe: GPIO 0, 3, 45, 46 dibiarkan KOSONG (0 load)
Biru/Kuning/Ungu: Sinyal Digital SPI, I2S & PWM
